headline: Nadeem leaps from 1,606th to 40th on ARC-3

sections.text: Nadeem gained 9.48 to reach 36.75 on the ARC-3 public board, moving from 1,606th to 40th in the past day. The team is still outside the gold places.

plzhecineedthis also climbed 253 places, from 335th to 82nd, reaching 34.54 with a gain of 2.58. The gold line, the score at 19th, rose 0.71 in the past day to 39.69, so both teams sit below the medal places on the public table.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
